query_policy: Query outputs may be created in the checkout but not common/per-worktree Git stores. Native note export retains full triple exclusion.
unknown_identity: Fail closed for file output when an admitted Git source identity cannot be established; its stores may live outside the selected repository (linked worktrees). Emit source access/Git-unavailable recovery, not ChooseNewOutput. Explicitly excluded Git sources impose no output guard.
preflight: Noncreating check catches existing/dangling target, missing/non-directory parent. OS permission failure may occur only at create after query reads; no promised no-read-on-permission-failure. No partial bytes/retryability claimed before destination writes.
shared_predicate: Core GitNotesListing exposes named native/query policies through one pure helper; both shells canonicalize parent. No duplicate root lists or presentation logic in QuerySource.
evidence: verification/git-source-output-safety.json; refined matrix pins exit/code and includes positive checkout output and Git-less nonGit output.
